stories.title: Luxxfolio announces a strategic investment in LitVM
stories.dek: Luxxfolio says it has made a strategic investment in LitVM, an EVM-compatible Layer 2 project developing smart contracts and applications for Litecoin. The release gives no investment amount or ownership percentage.
stories.status: Source checked October13 · Original publication date 2026-10-13
paragraphs: Luxxfolio says it has made a strategic investment in LitVM, an EVM-compatible Layer 2 project developing smart contracts and applications for Litecoin. The release gives no investment amount or ownership percentage.
An investment announcement is distinct from a mainnet launch or proven application adoption. The issuer explicitly warns that development objectives and positive returns are not assured.

stories.title: CFTC proposes expressly including certain event contracts as swaps
stories.classification: Official proposal · Not a final rule
stories.dek: The CFTC’s October 9 notice proposes further defining swap to include event contracts involving sports, politics, cultural and weather-related events. It requests written comments within 30 days of Federal Register publication.
stories.status: Source checked October13 · Original publication date 2026-10-09
paragraphs: The CFTC’s October 9 notice proposes further defining swap to include event contracts involving sports, politics, cultural and weather-related events. It requests written comments within 30 days of Federal Register publication.
This is the agency’s proposal and stated position. The release date alone does not establish the comment deadline or a final legal outcome.

stories.title: CFTC announces a casino-style gambling exclusion from swaps
stories.classification: Official interim final rule · Publication conditions apply
stories.dek: The CFTC says its interim final rule codifies an exclusion for casino-style gambling products, including sportsbook and casino-game wagers. Its release states effectiveness begins on Federal Register publication, with a 30-day comment period.
stories.status: Source checked October13 · Original publication date 2026-10-09

Keep this action separate from the event-contract proposal announced the same day. These releases do not announce a Litecoin fund approval or a crypto-wide exemption.
